bengaluru.name: Bengaluru GP
bengaluru.characterNote: Short, tight, technical city circuit. Many laps, hard to pass, driver-dominated.
funFacts: Tightest sequence of corners on the calendar
Track position is everything — overtaking is rare
Warm evenings keep tyre temps high

monsoon_bay.name: Monsoon Bay GP
monsoon_bay.characterNote: Tropical circuit infamous for sudden downpours. Weather and wet-tyre gambles decide races.
funFacts: Highest rain chance on the calendar
Storms can arrive within a single lap
Brutal humidity — drivers lose fluids fast

veloce.name: Veloce GP
veloce.characterNote: Temple of speed. Long straights, easy overtaking, rewards raw engine power. Low pit loss.
funFacts: Highest top speeds of the season
Lowest-downforce setups used here
Slipstream battles make for thrilling finishes

harbour_lights.name: Harbour Lights GP
harbour_lights.characterNote: Legendary street circuit. Almost impossible to overtake — qualifying and track position are king. Most laps on the calendar.
funFacts: Barriers line every corner — no room for error
Overtaking is nearly impossible
A driver's circuit above all others

sol_desert.name: Sol Desert GP
sol_desert.characterNote: Scorching desert night race. Extreme heat shreds tyres — degradation is the dominant strategic factor.
funFacts: Hottest track temperatures of the year
Tyre wear is punishing — multi-stop strategies common
Run under floodlights to escape the daytime heat

highland.name: Highland GP
highland.characterNote: Short, fast lap nestled in the mountains. Quick laps mean many of them; elevation and weather add spice.
funFacts: Largest elevation changes on the calendar
Mountain weather is famously unpredictable
One of the shortest laps — completed in under 70 seconds

grand_savane.name: Grand Savane GP
grand_savane.characterNote: Long, flowing high-altitude circuit. Big lap, high pit loss makes the stop decision costly. Balanced challenge.
funFacts: Highest-altitude race — thinner air affects engines
Long lap rewards a well-balanced car
Costly pit lane makes every stop a big commitment

aurora.name: Aurora GP
aurora.characterNote: Cool northern circuit, flowing and fast. Lower temps are gentle on tyres but cold tyres are tricky to switch on.
funFacts: Coolest track temperatures of the season
Tyre warm-up is a real challenge here
Long northern dusk makes for a stunning backdrop
